hypothesis.question: Do genetically identical cells express the same gene at the same level?
hypothesis.claim: In an isogenic E. coli population under constant basal conditions, cell-to-cell stochastic variation in gene expression produces substantial heterogeneity in protein/mRNA-linked readouts across seeds, even though all cells share identical genotype and environment — i.e. expression noise is intrinsic to the gene-expression process, not just extrinsic environmental variation.
hypothesis.h1: Across independent stochastic seeds (genetically identical cells, same wildtype/basal condition), the coefficient of variation (CV) of ribosome_conc (and correlated fraction_trna_charged) across seeds is substantial (CV >= 15%), reflecting intrinsic noise in gene expression rather than measurement replicate noise alone.
hypothesis.h0: Cell-to-cell variation across seeds is negligible/noise-floor only: CV of ribosome_conc across seeds in wildtype/basal is < 5%, i.e. isogenic cells under identical conditions express genes at effectively the same level (no meaningful intrinsic heterogeneity).

operational_defs.observable: ribosome_conc channel (active ribosome concentration), a proxy for ribosomal protein/rRNA expression output
operational_defs.measure: per-seed steady-state value of ribosome_conc at end of simulated generations, pooled across seeds

operational_defs.observable: distribution of per-seed ribosome_conc values under identical wildtype/basal condition
operational_defs.measure: coefficient of variation (SD/mean) across seeds; also bimodality coefficient to check for discrete subpopulations

operational_defs.observable: fraction_trna_charged channel
operational_defs.measure: per-seed CV across seeds, used as a correlated secondary channel

hypothesis.predicted_effect: Direction: positive — isogenic cells show non-trivial dispersion. Magnitude: CV(ribosome_conc) across seeds >= 15% in wildtype/basal (vs an assumed instrument/measurement noise floor of ~3-5% from technical replication alone), and the pooled per-seed distribution is approximately unimodal (bimodality coefficient <= 0.555) rather than bimodal — i.e. noise is continuous/graded, not a discrete bistable switch, under basal conditions.

falsifier.decision_rule: Compute CV (SD/mean) of ribosome_conc across seeds for wildtype/basal at generation 3. If CV < 5%, treat variation as noise-floor only and reject H1 (cells are effectively homogeneous). Separately, run bimodality_bc on pooled per-seed ribosome_conc values; if BC > 0.555 report a discrete subpopulation structure (refutes the 'graded unimodal noise' sub-claim) rather than continuous noise.
falsifier.refuting_result: CV(ribosome_conc) across 8 seeds < 5% (isogenic cells converge to essentially the same expression level) OR bimodality_bc > 0.555 indicating a discrete bistable split rather than continuous graded noise.

test.statistic: sarle_bimodality_coefficient over pooled per-seed ribosome_conc (plus CV computed directly from per-seed spread)
test.threshold: BC>0.555 flags bimodal; CV<5% (from per-seed spread) flags noise-floor/homogeneous, both would refute H1 as stated

rivals.claim: Rival A (extrinsic-only noise): apparent heterogeneity is driven entirely by extrinsic factors (e.g. slightly different growth-rate trajectories or metabolic state per seed), not by intrinsic stochasticity of the gene-expression machinery itself.
rivals.distinguishing_result: If Rival A is true, ribosome_conc CV across seeds should track tightly with growth_rate CV across the same seeds (near-perfect co-variation, high shared variance) and should collapse to near the noise floor if growth_rate is held essentially constant (e.g. via rrna_operon_knockout clamping ribosome capacity, which removes one source of extrinsic growth coupling) — i.e. the CV would NOT be intrinsic to the expression process per se but a downstream reflection of growth-rate fluctuations.

rivals.claim: Rival B (bistable/discrete subpopulations, not continuous noise): the population is not continuously variable but instead splits into 2+ discrete phenotypic states (e.g. a stringent vs relaxed subpopulation), driven by a switch-like regulatory mechanism (e.g. ppGpp-RelA feedback) rather than simple additive stochastic noise.
rivals.distinguishing_result: If Rival B is true, bimodality_bc on pooled ribosome_conc (and ppgpp_conc) would exceed 0.555, revealing two separated clusters rather than one continuous spread; a relA gene_knockout control would abolish this bimodality if ppGpp-driven switching is the cause, collapsing the distribution to unimodal.

auxiliary_assumptions: Seeds in this simulator encode independent stochastic realizations of the same genotype/condition, so seed-to-seed spread is a valid proxy for cell-to-cell (isogenic population) heterogeneity.
ribosome_conc at generation 3 approximates a quasi-steady-state readout comparable across seeds (not dominated by transient startup dynamics).

The instrument's technical/measurement noise floor for ribosome_conc across replicate seeds of an otherwise-deterministic process is roughly 3-5% CV (assumed baseline, not separately measured here) — used only as a qualitative anchor for 'noise-floor only' vs 'substantial heterogeneity'.

fraction_trna_charged under steady-state charging mode is reported as 20 per-amino-acid values broadcast over 86 columns; we treat the per-seed aggregate pattern as a secondary corroborating channel, not the primary test channel.

Distinguishing extrinsic vs intrinsic noise sources in the strict Elowitz two-reporter sense is beyond this simulator's instrumentation; we approximate via growth_rate co-variation and the rrna_operon_knockout control as the closest feasible interventional proxy, per auxiliary scope caveat.

drafts.question: Do genetically identical cells express the same gene at the same level?
drafts.claim: In an isogenic E. coli population growing in identical (basal) medium, gene expression readouts (ppGpp concentration and tRNA-charging fraction, as proxies for expression-linked physiological state) show substantial cell-to-cell variability (intrinsic noise) rather than a single fixed level: across independent stochastic seeds, the coefficient of variation (CV) of ppgpp_conc is >=20%, i.e. cells are NOT expressing identically despite identical genotype and environment.
drafts.h1: Across isogenic replicate seeds under identical wildtype/basal conditions, per-seed ppgpp_conc (and fraction_trna_charged) values show a CV >= 20%, reflecting substantial intrinsic expression noise between genetically identical cells.
drafts.h0: Per-seed ppgpp_conc values under wildtype/basal are tightly clustered (CV < 20%, effectively deterministic given genotype+environment), i.e. isogenic cells express the gene/pathway at essentially the same level, with only negligible measurement-level scatter.

operational_defs.construct: gene expression level in a single cell
operational_defs.observable: ppgpp_conc (and fraction_trna_charged as a secondary proxy of charging/translation state)
operational_defs.measure: per-seed steady-state value of ppgpp_conc (uM) recorded at the same generation across 8 independent seeds

operational_defs.observable: dispersion of per-seed ppgpp_conc values pooled across seeds
operational_defs.measure: coefficient of variation (SD/mean) of per-seed ppgpp_conc; also Sarle's bimodality coefficient to check for discrete subpopulations

operational_defs.observable: wildtype/basal design with no gene_knockout or tf_activity perturbation, varying only seed
operational_defs.measure: candidate_designs perturbation=wildtype, condition=basal, seeds=8

drafts.predicted_effect: Positive, substantial noise: CV(ppgpp_conc) across 8 wildtype/basal seeds >= 20% (point estimate ~25-35%), and the pooled distribution is unimodal (BC <= 0.555) rather than bimodal — i.e. continuous noise, not a discrete two-state switch. A rrna_operon_knockout control (reduced ribosome capacity, confounding growth) should NOT by itself explain the noise magnitude if intrinsic stochasticity is the driver.

falsifier.decision_rule: Compute coefficient of variation (SD/mean) of per-seed ppgpp_conc across 8 wildtype/basal seeds at generation 3; H1 requires CV>=20%. Separately run power_mde to confirm 8 seeds can detect a 20% CV against measurement-noise floor. Also run bimodality_bc on the pooled per-seed values to check unimodality (BC<=0.555 supports continuous noise over discrete bimodal subpopulations).
falsifier.refuting_result: CV(ppgpp_conc) < 20% across the 8 seeds (cells are essentially identical, noise is within instrument/measurement floor) OR power_mde shows 8 seeds cannot even in principle detect a 20% CV (underpowered design, cannot distinguish H1 from H0) OR bimodality_bc > 0.555 indicating a discrete two-state (not continuous noise) population, contradicting the stated continuous-noise form.

test.statistic: CV (SD/mean) of per-seed ppgpp_conc; min detectable effect at n=8
test.threshold: CV>=20% AND MDE_at_n8 <= 20% (i.e., design is powered to detect the claimed effect); secondary: BC<=0.555

rivals.claim: Apparent 'noise' is actually a bimodal/discrete two-state switch (e.g. stringent-response ON/OFF subpopulations) rather than continuous intrinsic noise.
rivals.distinguishing_result: bimodality_bc on pooled per-seed ppgpp_conc yields BC>0.555, indicating a genuine two-cluster split rather than a single noisy distribution.

rivals.claim: Observed cell-to-cell spread is driven by extrinsic/ribosome-capacity differences (varying ribosome allocation per seed) rather than intrinsic stochastic gene expression noise.
rivals.distinguishing_result: An rrna_operon_knockout control that caps ribosome capacity should SHRINK or systematically shift the CV of ppgpp_conc relative to wildtype/basal if ribosome-capacity variation (an extrinsic, mechanistically coupled driver) is the dominant source; if CV stays similarly large and unshifted in direction, this rival is disfavored.

rivals.claim: The measured spread is simply simulator/numerical seed-to-seed noise (stochastic integrator artifact) with no biological interpretation, i.e. CV reflects implementation noise floor, not biology.
rivals.distinguishing_result: power_mde shows that even a non-biological artifact-level CV (e.g. from a deterministic steady-state calculation replicated across seeds with no stochastic module engaged) would already produce CV>=20%, meaning the test cannot distinguish biological noise from numerical artifact at this n -> this would flag the test as underpowered/confounded rather than confirming H1.

auxiliary_assumptions: Per-seed stochastic variation in this simulator is intended to approximate intrinsic biological noise (bounded-dose Gillespie-like or equivalent stochastic kinetics), not purely a numerical artifact; this cannot be fully disentangled within the simulator and is treated as a scope caveat.
ppgpp_conc and fraction_trna_charged are adequate proxies for 'gene expression level' at the whole-cell summary scale available; single-mRNA-copy-number noise is not directly queried here.
8 seeds at generation 3 is assumed sufficient for the steady-state charging module to have converged (avoiding early-transient inflation of apparent variance).
Basal condition and no additional perturbation hold genetic background and media truly identical across seeds, so any between-seed spread is attributable to the seed (stochastic) axis only.

drafts.question: Do genetically identical cells express the same gene at the same level?
drafts.claim: In an isogenic E. coli population growing in constant basal medium, gene expression at a given locus is not uniform across cells: intrinsic stochastic noise in transcription/translation produces substantial cell-to-cell variability in expressed protein level, even though all cells share identical genotype and environment. Concretely, the population distribution of a representative gene's expression readout (modeled via ribosome_conc / protein_mass as bulk proxies for expression capacity, and fraction_trna_charged as a sensitive single-species proxy for translational state) shows a coefficient of variation (CV) across seeds substantially greater than zero (CV >= 0.15), reflecting noise rather than measurement error.
drafts.h1: Across isogenic replicate cells (seeds) in the same static condition, the per-seed distribution of a representative expression-proxy channel (ribosome_conc) has CV >= 0.15, i.e., meaningfully more variable than tight technical/numerical noise (CV ~ 0.02-0.05 expected from a near-deterministic bulk ODE readout).
drafts.h0: Per-seed variability in ribosome_conc (and protein_mass) across isogenic wildtype replicates is indistinguishable from baseline numerical/integration noise (CV < 0.05), i.e., genetically identical cells in identical conditions express genes at effectively the same level up to simulator noise floor.

operational_defs.observable: ribosome_conc channel recorded per seed at a fixed generation under wildtype/basal
operational_defs.measure: coefficient of variation (CV = sd/mean) computed across seeds; also used as per-seed spread input to disconfirm

operational_defs.observable: protein_mass and ribosome_conc channels
operational_defs.measure: per-seed terminal value at generation 3-4, pooled across seeds

operational_defs.observable: fraction_trna_charged channel (steady-state: 20 per-aa values)
operational_defs.measure: CV across seeds of the pooled per-seed mean fraction_trna_charged

drafts.predicted_effect: Positive, modest-to-moderate dispersion: CV(ribosome_conc) across 6-8 seeds >= 0.15 (i.e. >=3x the ~0.02-0.05 CV expected from numerical/integration noise alone), with per-seed spread in disconfirm() showing non-trivial z_vs_corpus_spread (>1). No systematic shift in the MEAN (welch_t vs a second wildtype batch should be <2), only in variance/spread -- distinguishing noise from a mean-shifting perturbation.

falsifier.decision_rule: Compute CV of per-seed terminal ribosome_conc across 8 seeds in one wildtype/basal batch (batch A) and compare its spread to a second independent wildtype/basal batch (batch B, different seed set) via disconfirm(); treat CV>=0.15 in each batch AND welch_t<2 between batch means as evidence for H1 (variance-only effect). Refute H1 if CV<0.05 in both batches (noise floor) or if welch_t>=2 (indicating a mean-shift/systematic artifact rather than stochastic noise).
falsifier.refuting_result: Both wildtype batches show CV(ribosome_conc) < 0.05 across seeds, i.e., replicates are numerically near-identical, matching H0 (no meaningful intrinsic expression noise above simulator floor).

test.statistic: welch_t on ribosome_conc means (batch A vs batch B) plus reported per-seed CV/spread
test.threshold: |welch_t| < 2 (no mean shift) AND CV >= 0.15 in both batches (confirms dispersion); refute if CV < 0.05

rivals.claim: Apparent variability is an artifact of insufficient seed sampling or RNG seeding scheme, not real biological noise.
rivals.distinguishing_result: If CV shrinks toward <0.05 as seeds increase from 6 to 8 with no plateau, or if CV is unstable/non-reproducible across two independent wildtype batches (batch A vs batch B diverge wildly), this points to sampling artifact rather than a stable noise property.

rivals.claim: Any observed spread is driven by extrinsic/mean-shifting factors (e.g., slow drift in growth_rate or division timing across seeds) rather than intrinsic per-gene expression noise.
rivals.distinguishing_result: A rrna_operon_knockout control that caps ribosome capacity should, if the rival is true, still show the SAME relative CV pattern (since drift-driven variability is not gene-specific); if instead CV collapses or changes qualitatively under rrna_operon_knockout, that supports an allocation/capacity-coupled mechanism rather than pure intrinsic noise.

auxiliary_assumptions: ribosome_conc and protein_mass are adequate bulk proxies for 'gene expression level' in this whole-cell model (no single-gene fluorescent reporter channel exists; we treat ribosome_conc as a representative highly-expressed, growth-coupled gene class).
Seeds encode independent stochastic realizations of the same genotype/environment (isogenic condition satisfied by construction).

Numerical/integration noise floor is assumed to be low (CV ~0.02-0.05); this is an assumption about simulator baseline, not independently verified here, and is treated as an auxiliary premise per Duhem-Quine.
Terminal-generation (gen 3-4) readout is representative of steady-state per-seed variability and not an artifact of early transient dynamics.
The simulator's stochastic charging/kinetic modules (if invoked) are not required for this test; steady-state charging suffices since we are probing bulk proxy noise, not per-tRNA kinetic noise.

params.note: independent batch B for spread-reproducibility check, same condition different seed draw

drafts.question: Do genetically identical cells express the same gene at the same level?
drafts.claim: Isogenic E. coli cells grown in identical (basal) conditions show substantial cell-to-cell variability in gene expression output, operationalized as the per-seed spread (coefficient of variation, CV) in fraction_trna_charged and ribosome_conc across independent stochastic replicates, rather than converging to a single shared value.
drafts.h1: Across isogenic replicate seeds under identical wildtype/basal conditions, the per-seed CV of ribosome_conc (and fraction_trna_charged) is large (CV >= 0.15, i.e. >=15%), reflecting intrinsic stochastic noise in gene expression rather than measurement artifact.
drafts.h0: Per-seed CV of ribosome_conc (and fraction_trna_charged) across isogenic wildtype/basal replicates is small (CV < 0.15), i.e. cells are effectively homogeneous and seed-to-seed differences reflect only numerical/sampling noise near zero.

operational_defs.observable: ribosome_conc and fraction_trna_charged channels, recorded per seed per generation under steady-state charging
operational_defs.measure: per-seed terminal-generation value; aggregate as coefficient of variation (CV = SD/mean) across seeds within a condition

operational_defs.observable: distribution shape of per-seed ribosome_conc values pooled across seeds
operational_defs.measure: Sarle's bimodality coefficient (BC) over pooled per-seed values; CV as primary magnitude measure

operational_defs.observable: comparison of CV in wildtype/basal vs a rrna_operon_knockout background (which caps ribosome synthesis capacity, testing whether variability scales with regulatory room) and vs ppgpp_conc clamp (removes stringent-response-driven variability)
operational_defs.measure: difference in CV and welch_t on per-seed means between conditions

drafts.predicted_effect: Direction: positive, substantial heterogeneity. Magnitude: CV(ribosome_conc) across seeds in wildtype/basal >= 0.15 (15%), CV(fraction_trna_charged) >= 0.10; pooled distribution is unimodal (not bimodal, BC < 0.555) reflecting continuous stochastic noise rather than a discrete two-state switch. Clamping ppGpp (ppgpp_conc=1x) is predicted to reduce CV(ribosome_conc) by roughly 30-50% relative to wildtype/basal, implicating stringent-response-coupled noise as a major but not sole contributor.

falsifier.decision_rule: Compute CV(ribosome_conc) across seeds within wildtype/basal at the terminal generation. Also run bimodality_bc on pooled per-seed values. H1 requires CV>=0.15; refute if CV<0.15 (treat as power_mde check: compare observed CV to min-detectable-CV at n seeds). Separately, Welch t of ribosome_conc for ppgpp_conc=1x vs wildtype/basal across seeds; if |t|<2, the ppGpp-clamp control fails to show the predicted noise reduction, weakening the stringent-response attribution (but does not by itself refute core heterogeneity claim).
falsifier.refuting_result: CV(ribosome_conc) across the 6-8 wildtype/basal seeds is < 0.15 (cells converge tightly to a shared value) and BC<0.555 confirms unimodality but with low spread, OR the observed CV is below the min-detectable-effect at this seed count, meaning we cannot distinguish 'homogeneous' from 'noisy' and must treat H0 as unresolved rather than confirmed.

test.statistic: CV with min-detectable-effect power check at n=8 seeds
test.threshold: CV>=0.15 to reject H0; if CV falls below MDE at n=8, result is inconclusive not confirmatory

rivals.claim: Rival A (deterministic homogeneity): apparent seed-to-seed differences are purely numerical/integration noise with no biological basis; true single-cell expression is essentially fixed by the deterministic FBA/kinetic backbone.
rivals.distinguishing_result: If true, CV(ribosome_conc) across wildtype/basal seeds would be near the simulator's numerical noise floor (very small, e.g. <0.05) and would NOT increase when intrinsic stochastic modules (kinetic charging) are engaged relative to steady-state charging.

rivals.claim: Rival B (ppGpp/stringent-response is the dominant and essentially sole noise source): variability is almost entirely driven by stochastic ppGpp pulses (RelA/SpoT dynamics), not by ribosome-synthesis noise per se.
rivals.distinguishing_result: If true, clamping ppgpp_conc to a fixed multiple of basal would collapse CV(ribosome_conc) to near the Rival-A noise floor (>70% reduction), rather than the partial 30-50% reduction predicted by H1, and a rrna_operon_knockout (which does not touch ppGpp machinery) would show little change in relative CV.

auxiliary_assumptions: Seed-to-seed variation in the simulator is intended to represent genuine intrinsic stochastic noise (molecular-level fluctuations in transcription/translation/charging), not merely pseudo-random-number-generator artifact; we cannot fully disentangle deterministic chaos from true stochastic noise within this simulator and record that as a scope caveat.
Terminal-generation (gen 3) snapshot is representative of steady-state single-cell variability and not dominated by transient initial-condition effects.

Ribosome_conc and fraction_trna_charged are read under steady-state charging mode (not kinetic) for this design, consistent with channel availability notes; kinetic-charging comparisons are left for a follow-up design.

rrna_operon_knockout and relA knockout backgrounds remain viable enough (division_rate not collapsed to 0) over 3 generations to yield interpretable per-seed CV; if division_rate <1 in these KOs, variability estimates may be confounded by survivorship and will be flagged rather than over-interpreted.

drafts.question: Do genetically identical cells express the same gene at the same level?
drafts.claim: Isogenic E. coli cells growing in identical (basal) medium show substantial cell-to-cell variability in expression of a given gene's downstream readouts (ppGpp/ribosome-related channels), rather than uniform expression — i.e. intrinsic/extrinsic noise produces a broad, non-degenerate distribution across replicate seeds even though genotype and environment are held fixed.
drafts.h1: Across isogenic replicate simulations (same genotype, same static basal condition, differing only in stochastic seed), the per-seed distribution of ppgpp_conc (and correspondingly ribosome_conc) has coefficient of variation (CV) >= 0.20, i.e. cells do NOT express the gene-linked readout at the same level despite identical genotype.
drafts.h0: Isogenic replicate seeds under wildtype/basal show CV < 0.20 for ppgpp_conc (and ribosome_conc), consistent with expression being essentially deterministic/uniform across genetically identical cells (variability attributable only to measurement/sim noise floor).

operational_defs.observable: ppgpp_conc and ribosome_conc channel values recorded per seed at matched generation/timepoint
operational_defs.measure: per-seed steady-state (or end-of-generation) value of ppgpp_conc and ribosome_conc, pooled across 6-8 seeds

operational_defs.observable: spread of per-seed ppgpp_conc/ribosome_conc values under wildtype/basal
operational_defs.measure: coefficient of variation (SD/mean) across seeds; also Sarle's bimodality coefficient to check for sub-population structure

operational_defs.observable: wildtype genotype, no gene_knockout/new_gene perturbation applied
operational_defs.measure: design label wildtype/basal with varying seed only

drafts.predicted_effect: Pooled across 6-8 seeds of wildtype/basal, ppgpp_conc will show CV ~0.20-0.35 (i.e. >=20% relative spread) and ribosome_conc CV ~0.15-0.25, both well above a trivial noise floor (CV<0.05); distribution is expected to be unimodal (BC<0.555) rather than bimodal, consistent with continuous noise rather than discrete subpopulations.

falsifier.decision_rule: power_check: compute CV of ppgpp_conc across the 6-8 seeds; treat H1 as supported only if CV>=0.20, which must also exceed the min detectable effect (MDE) at n=6-8 seeds per power_mde; if observed CV<0.20 or is indistinguishable from the sim's intrinsic noise floor (MDE not cleared), refute H1 of substantial intrinsic variability.
falsifier.refuting_result: Per-seed CV of ppgpp_conc < 0.20 and below the MDE threshold for n=6-8 seeds, indicating isogenic cells express the readout essentially uniformly (variability consistent with numerical/sampling noise only), refuting the claim of substantial expression heterogeneity.

test.statistic: coefficient_of_variation_vs_MDE
test.threshold: CV>=0.20 AND CV exceeds MDE at n=6-8

rivals.claim: Rival A (deterministic-dominant): any observed spread across seeds is purely numerical/integration noise from the steady-state solver, not biologically meaningful cell-to-cell variability — the 'noise' would vanish or shrink proportionally if the model were run with a finer-grained kinetic charging module.
rivals.distinguishing_result: If the coarse_kinetic or kinetic elongation_model run of wildtype/basal shows the SAME or LARGER CV as steady_state (not smaller), this rejects the pure-solver-artifact rival; if kinetic CV collapses toward the noise floor, rival A is supported instead of H1.

rivals.claim: Rival B (bimodal/discrete-state driven, not continuous noise): the population variability actually reflects discrete bistable sub-states (e.g. a stringent-response ON/OFF switch) rather than continuous graded noise, so a single CV number mischaracterizes the distribution shape.
rivals.distinguishing_result: If Sarle's bimodality coefficient on pooled ppgpp_conc values exceeds 0.555, the distribution is bimodal, supporting Rival B over the continuous-noise H1 (which predicts BC<0.555).

drafts.question: Do genetically identical cells express the same gene at the same level?
drafts.claim: Isogenic E. coli cells growing in identical media exhibit substantial cell-to-cell variability (noise) in gene expression, operationalized here via the stringent-response regulon (RelA concentration and ppGpp concentration), such that across replicate seeds the coefficient of variation (CV) of rela_conc and ppgpp_conc exceeds 20%, rather than cells converging on a single shared expression level.
drafts.h1: Across isogenic replicate seeds under identical wildtype/basal conditions, the per-seed distribution of rela_conc (and correspondingly ppgpp_conc) shows substantial dispersion: CV >= 20%, reflecting intrinsic/extrinsic noise rather than a single fixed expression level.
drafts.h0: Isogenic cells under identical conditions express the gene at a shared level: per-seed CV of rela_conc (and ppgpp_conc) is low (<10%), consistent with deterministic, noise-free expression dictated entirely by genotype+environment.

operational_defs.construct: gene expression level of a representative regulatory gene (relA)
operational_defs.observable: rela_conc channel
operational_defs.measure: per-seed steady-state concentration (uM) sampled at end of simulated generations, pooled across seeds

operational_defs.observable: distribution of rela_conc (and ppgpp_conc) across seeds within one condition
operational_defs.measure: coefficient of variation (SD/mean) computed across seeds; bimodality coefficient to detect discrete subpopulations

operational_defs.observable: ppgpp_conc channel
operational_defs.measure: per-seed concentration, correlated with rela_conc spread

drafts.predicted_effect: Direction: positive — isogenic population shows dispersion, not convergence. Magnitude: CV(rela_conc) across seeds >= 20% (vs <10% expected under a deterministic null), and CV(ppgpp_conc) similarly elevated (>=20%). Distribution shape: unimodal but wide (not multiple discrete subpopulations) is the baseline expectation; a bimodality coefficient > 0.555 would indicate an unexpected discrete-switch phenomenon worth flagging separately.

falsifier.decision_rule: Compute CV (SD/mean) of rela_conc pooled across 8 seeds at matched generation under wildtype/basal; this is a one-design dispersion test, NOT a two-group mean comparison. Operationally: treat the 8 per-seed values as the sample and apply power_mde to check if observed spread exceeds the min-detectable-effect noise floor for n=8, OR use welch_disconfirm between two independently-seeded halves (seeds 1-4 vs 5-8) of the same wildtype/basal design as a proxy reference/target pair to confirm no systematic sub-batch divergence while confirming within-batch CV>=20%.
falsifier.refuting_result: If pooled CV(rela_conc) < 10% across 8 seeds (cells converge tightly on one value) and welch_t between seed-halves is non-significant with effect_pct near 0, this refutes H1 (no meaningful noise) and supports H0.

test.statistic: CV (SD/mean) across seeds; min-detectable-effect check
test.threshold: CV >= 20% to confirm H1; CV < 10% refutes H1 in favor of H0

rivals.claim: Rival A — Noise exists but is confined to ppGpp/stringent-response machinery specifically (a stress-sensing module evolved for bet-hedging) and is NOT a general property of gene expression; most genes would show low CV.
rivals.distinguishing_result: Run an rrna_operon_knockout (which perturbs ribosome capacity, a different arm of growth physiology unlinked to RelA synthesis regulation) and check if ribosome-associated readouts (growth_rate, protein_mass) ALSO show elevated CV across seeds; if only rela/ppgpp show noise while growth_rate CV stays low, this is consistent with Rival A (pathway-specific noise) rather than a general cellular noise claim.

rivals.claim: Rival B — Apparent variability is deterministic bistability driven by a hidden environmental/initial-condition difference across seeds (e.g. different random initial metabolite pools), not true stochastic gene-expression noise; a relA gene_knockout would show the SAME dispersion pattern in ppgpp_conc (now near-zero, driven by SpoT alone) if the variance source is extrinsic/numerical rather than relA-expression-specific.
rivals.distinguishing_result: If relA_knockout/basal shows ppgpp_conc CV collapses toward near-zero (since RelA-driven bursts are removed) rather than persisting at >=20%, this supports H1 (RelA expression noise specifically drives ppGpp variability); if CV stays similarly high even with relA removed, this supports Rival B (variability has another, non-relA-expression source).

auxiliary_assumptions: The simulator's intrinsic stochastic seed-to-seed variation is a valid proxy for biological cell-to-cell expression noise (the model's RNG captures the relevant noise sources: transcriptional bursting, partitioning at division, etc.).
rela_conc and ppgpp_conc are measured at a matched generation/timepoint across seeds so that differences reflect steady-state dispersion, not transient drift.
8 seeds is sufficient replicate depth to estimate CV with acceptable precision (acknowledged as a power limitation; power_mde test explicitly checks this).

The relA gene_knockout is mechanistically simulated (removes RelA-driven ppGpp synthesis) rather than being a no-op in this model build; this is flagged as a downstream-checkable assumption per the platform note.
Growth condition (basal) is held fixed across all designs so that condition-driven variability does not confound the intrinsic-noise measurement.

drafts.claim: In a genetically identical (isogenic) E. coli population growing in constant basal medium, single-cell gene expression is NOT uniform: stochastic noise in transcription/translation produces substantial cell-to-cell variability in protein/ribosome content, quantifiable as a coefficient of variation (CV) of ribosome concentration across seeds of ~15-30%, i.e. far above the <5% CV expected from a purely deterministic (noise-free) model.
drafts.h1: Across isogenic replicate seeds under identical wildtype/basal conditions, the per-seed distribution of ribosome_conc (and corroborating fraction_trna_charged) shows a CV >= 15%, reflecting intrinsic stochastic gene-expression noise rather than measurement/seed-handling artifact.
drafts.h0: Per-seed ribosome_conc values under wildtype/basal are effectively homogeneous: CV < 5%, consistent with deterministic, noise-free expression where identical genotype + identical environment yields identical expression level up to negligible numerical noise.

operational_defs.observable: ribosome_conc channel value recorded per seed at the end of each run (steady-state charging)
operational_defs.measure: coefficient of variation (SD/mean) of ribosome_conc computed across seeds within the wildtype/basal design

operational_defs.construct: corroborating expression noise in a second axis
operational_defs.observable: fraction_trna_charged channel (broadcast per-amino-acid values) per seed
operational_defs.measure: CV across seeds of the mean fraction_trna_charged, used as a secondary, non-ribosomal confirmation of the same heterogeneity claim

operational_defs.construct: population growth heterogeneity (control for whether noise is physiologically consequential)
operational_defs.observable: growth_rate channel per seed
operational_defs.measure: CV across seeds of growth_rate, checked for correlation-free independence from ribosome_conc CV to rule out trivial scaling artifacts

drafts.predicted_effect: Positive, population-wide effect: CV(ribosome_conc) across seeds >= 15% (point estimate ~20%) under wildtype/basal, i.e. at least 3-4x the <5% CV expected under a deterministic null. This is a DISTRIBUTION claim about the isogenic population, not a single-pair difference.

falsifier.decision_rule: power_mde check first to confirm 6-8 seeds can resolve a 15% CV against instrument noise floor; then compute CV of ribosome_conc across seeds pooled within the wildtype/basal design and compare to the <5% deterministic-null threshold using the power_mde minimum-detectable-effect framework (reject H1/treat as noise-floor-limited if observed CV falls below the MDE for n=8 seeds, i.e. CV effectively indistinguishable from 5%)
falsifier.refuting_result: Observed CV(ribosome_conc) across the 8 wildtype/basal seeds is <5% (at or below the minimum detectable effect for this seed count), meaning the population looks homogeneous and any apparent spread is attributable to simulator numerical noise rather than genuine expression heterogeneity.

test.statistic: CV (SD/mean) of ribosome_conc across seeds; min detectable effect at n=8
test.threshold: reject H1 if observed CV < MDE_at_n8, operationally CV < 5%

rivals.claim: Rival A - Deterministic/numerical-artifact: any apparent variability across seeds is purely simulator floating-point / integration noise, not biological stochastic gene expression, so increasing seeds or generations would not reveal a stable non-trivial CV structure.
rivals.distinguishing_result: If Rival A is true, CV(ribosome_conc) stays <5% and does NOT scale with generations (i.e., no accumulation of divergence across 1 vs 4 generations), and the companion fraction_trna_charged CV also stays near-zero and uncorrelated with any real biological channel.

rivals.claim: Rival B - Growth-rate-driven heterogeneity: apparent ribosome_conc variability is not autonomous expression noise but a secondary consequence of seed-to-seed differences in instantaneous growth_rate (since ribosome content scales with growth rate via the growth-law), so the 'noise' is actually a deterministic function of growth-rate variation, not independent stochasticity.
rivals.distinguishing_result: If Rival B is true, CV(ribosome_conc) across seeds would be reducible to (strongly predicted by) CV(growth_rate) across the SAME seeds (high correlation/collinearity), rather than an independent noise source; a rrna_operon_knockout control (below) that perturbs ribosome capacity directly, while holding growth conditions similarly basal, would show ribosome_conc CV decoupled from growth_rate CV if true intrinsic noise is present beyond the growth-rate channel.

auxiliary_assumptions: Steady-state charging mode is used (not kinetic), so ribosome_conc is a valid, directly-recorded channel rather than requiring ribosomal-protein-count proxies.

Seed-to-seed variability in the simulator is intended to represent genuine intrinsic/extrinsic stochastic gene-expression noise (e.g., bursty transcription/translation events), not purely numerical integration artifacts; this is an assumption the simulator's design is presumed, not independently verified, to satisfy.
All seeds are run under identical basal condition and identical parameterization except the random seed itself, so any CV reflects stochasticity rather than confounded condition differences.
Generations 1-3 is assumed sufficient for ribosome_conc to reach a quasi-steady per-cell level at which cross-seed comparison is meaningful (i.e., we are not capturing transient startup artifacts).

The deterministic-null CV threshold of <5% is a reasonable proxy for 'numerical noise floor' given typical ODE/FBA solver tolerances in this class of whole-cell models; this threshold is not independently calibrated here and is treated as an auxiliary convention.

drafts.question: Do genetically identical cells express the same gene at the same level?
drafts.claim: Isogenic E. coli cells growing under identical (basal) conditions exhibit substantial cell-to-cell variability in gene expression output, quantified here via ribosome concentration and ppGpp concentration as proxies for the translational/stringent-response machinery, such that the across-seed coefficient of variation (CV) in these channels is large (CV >= 15%) rather than near-zero as expected if expression were deterministic across isogenic cells.
drafts.h1: Across independent stochastic replicates (seeds) of genetically identical wildtype cells in the same static condition, the per-seed distribution of ribosome_conc (and ppgpp_conc) shows substantial dispersion: CV >= 15%, reflecting intrinsic gene-expression noise rather than measurement/replicate artifact.
drafts.h0: Per-seed values of ribosome_conc (and ppgpp_conc) across isogenic wildtype replicates are tightly clustered (CV < 15%), i.e. expression is effectively deterministic given the condition, with only negligible stochastic variation.

operational_defs.observable: ribosome_conc channel per seed
operational_defs.measure: mean and CV (SD/mean) of ribosome_conc across seeds within a design

operational_defs.observable: ppgpp_conc channel per seed
operational_defs.measure: mean and CV of ppgpp_conc across seeds within a design

operational_defs.observable: spread of per-seed channel values at fixed condition/generation
operational_defs.measure: coefficient of variation (CV) and bimodality coefficient (BC) over pooled per-seed values

drafts.predicted_effect: Isogenic replicates show CV(ribosome_conc) >= 15% and CV(ppgpp_conc) >= 20% across seeds at matched condition/generation, with the pooled per-seed distribution approximately unimodal (BC <= 0.555) — i.e., substantial but continuous (not bimodal) noise, consistent with intrinsic stochastic gene expression rather than a bistable switch.

falsifier.decision_rule: Compute coefficient of variation (CV = SD/mean) of ribosome_conc across the 8 seeds at generation 3; separately compute Sarle's bimodality coefficient (BC) over the pooled per-seed values. Also run power_mde to confirm 8 seeds can detect a 15% CV effect above intrinsic replicate noise floor. Reject H1 (isogenic variability is negligible) if CV < 15% AND the power check shows this is not simply an underpowered null.
falsifier.refuting_result: CV(ribosome_conc) < 15% across seeds with power_mde confirming adequate sensitivity at n=8 to detect 15% CV — i.e., isogenic cells are near-deterministic in ribosome concentration, refuting substantial intrinsic noise.

test.statistic: CV (SD/mean) across seeds; min detectable effect at n=8
test.threshold: CV>=15% to confirm H1; refute if CV<15% and MDE at n=8 is <15% (i.e. well-powered to detect and still null)

rivals.claim: Apparent variability is driven mainly by cell-cycle/division-timing differences across seeds (extrinsic, deterministic-given-age noise), not by intrinsic stochastic gene expression per se.
rivals.distinguishing_result: If variability collapses (CV drops sharply) when comparing seeds at matched generation/division-cycle phase rather than wall-clock generation count, extrinsic cell-cycle phase — not intrinsic noise — explains most of the spread.

rivals.claim: Observed spread is an artifact of insufficient replicate sampling (seed-count too low), not a real biological signature of cell-to-cell heterogeneity.
rivals.distinguishing_result: If power_mde shows that at n=8 seeds the minimum detectable CV is itself >15%, the measured CV cannot be distinguished from sampling noise, so the apparent heterogeneity claim is underpowered rather than confirmed.

rivals.claim: Variability is primarily driven by stringent-response (ppGpp) pathway bistability/switching rather than general stochastic expression noise across the whole translational apparatus.
rivals.distinguishing_result: A relA gene_knockout (interventional control removing ppGpp synthesis capacity) that still shows comparable CV in ribosome_conc across seeds would indicate the noise is NOT ppGpp-pathway-specific but reflects broader intrinsic expression stochasticity; if CV collapses in the relA knockout, ppGpp-driven switching was the dominant source.

candidate_designs.timeline: optional scale-up only if n=8 underpowered per power_mde

drafts.question: Do genetically identical cells express the same gene at the same level?
drafts.claim: Isogenic E. coli cells growing in the same fixed medium show substantial cell-to-cell variability in gene expression output, operationalized here as the fraction of charged tRNA and ppGpp concentration (proxies for translational/stringent-response state that integrate expression noise), such that the across-seed coefficient of variation (CV) of these channels at steady state exceeds 15%, i.e. genetically identical cells do NOT express at the same level — expression is a distribution, not a point value.
drafts.h1: Across isogenic replicate seeds (same genotype, same condition), the per-seed distribution of ppgpp_conc and fraction_trna_charged has CV >= 15%, reflecting intrinsic/extrinsic noise in gene expression rather than measurement replicate noise alone.
drafts.h0: Isogenic replicate seeds under identical condition show tight convergence: CV of ppgpp_conc and fraction_trna_charged across seeds is < 15% (i.e., indistinguishable from simulator/measurement noise floor), consistent with cells expressing genes at effectively the same level.

operational_defs.observable: ppgpp_conc and fraction_trna_charged recorded per seed at matched generation under wildtype/basal
operational_defs.measure: across-seed CV (std/mean) pooled over seeds; also per-seed spread reported by disconfirm

operational_defs.observable: wildtype perturbation, fixed condition=basal, only seed varied
operational_defs.measure: seeds=8, generations=3, no gene_knockout or media shift

operational_defs.observable: same wildtype/basal design re-run with identical seeds (technical replicate proxy) is not separately available; floor approximated by requiring CV threshold well above typical simulator numerical jitter (~5%)
operational_defs.measure: CV threshold = 15%, set above assumed numerical floor of ~5%

drafts.predicted_effect: Direction: positive — isogenic populations show substantial dispersion, not convergence. Magnitude: across-seed CV of fraction_trna_charged ~15-25% and CV of ppgpp_conc ~20-35% at steady state (basal condition, gen 3), both well above an assumed ~5% numerical noise floor, consistent with known single-cell expression noise (CVs commonly 20-50% for low-copy regulators in E. coli literature).

falsifier.decision_rule: Compute across-seed CV of ppgpp_conc and fraction_trna_charged pooled over 8 seeds at generation 3; H1 requires CV>=15% for at least one channel. Separately, to rule out a trivial 'noise is everywhere' null, require that this spread is NOT an artifact of a single-cell outlier: Welch's t of per-seed ppgpp_conc split into two halves (low-seed-index vs high-seed-index) should NOT reject (|t|<2), confirming spread is genuine distributed noise not a bimodal seed-batch effect.
falsifier.refuting_result: If pooled across-seed CV for BOTH ppgpp_conc and fraction_trna_charged is <15% (cells converge tightly to a point value), H1 is refuted and cells behave as a deterministic point-estimate system under this genotype/condition.

test.statistic: Sarle's bimodality coefficient (BC) over pooled per-seed ppgpp_conc values, used descriptively alongside CV; primary decision uses CV>=15% threshold computed from per-seed spread output of disconfirm
test.threshold: CV>=15% (primary); BC>0.555 flags bimodal subpopulations as a secondary, more specific form of heterogeneity

rivals.claim: Apparent variability is driven by extrinsic/global noise shared across the whole regulatory network (e.g. ribosome allocation or growth-rate fluctuations), not gene-specific intrinsic stochasticity — so ppgpp_conc and fraction_trna_charged would co-vary tightly with growth_rate across seeds (a global confound), rather than reflecting independent per-gene noise.
rivals.distinguishing_result: If ppgpp_conc variability is just a readout of growth_rate variability, a rrna_operon_knockout (which perturbs ribosome capacity directly and should amplify growth-extrinsic noise) should inflate CV further in a way tightly coupled to growth_rate changes; if instead CV stays similarly elevated regardless of growth-rate shifts, that argues against a single global growth-noise driver.

rivals.claim: Observed across-seed spread is purely a stochastic-simulator numerical artifact (RNG/solver noise), not biologically meaningful expression noise, so it would NOT track with known noise-amplifying biology.
rivals.distinguishing_result: A relA gene_knockout (removing stringent-response machinery, which is a major source of regulatory noise amplification) should REDUCE ppgpp_conc CV substantially if the noise is biological/regulatory; if CV stays the same magnitude as wildtype even after relA knockout, that supports the numerical-artifact rival over genuine biological noise.

auxiliary_assumptions: Steady-state charging mode is used (not kinetic), so ppgpp_conc and fraction_trna_charged channels are recorded as specified for steady-state.
Seeds represent independent stochastic realizations of the same genotype/condition, i.e. a valid operationalization of 'isogenic cells' in this simulator.
Generation 3 is late enough to reach a quasi-steady distributional state but early enough to avoid confounds from population-level drift or division-rate defects.
The simulator's own numerical/solver noise floor is small relative to the 15% CV threshold (assumed ~5%); this is a modeling assumption the simulator cannot directly certify.

fraction_trna_charged and ppgpp_conc are accepted as adequate proxies for 'gene expression level' broadly, since no single generic 'gene expression' channel exists; this is a scope caveat on the operationalization.

drafts.question: Do genetically identical cells express the same gene at the same level?
drafts.claim: Isogenic E. coli cells under identical steady-state conditions (wildtype/basal) display substantial cell-to-cell variability in expression of a given gene/pathway, manifesting as a broad, right-skewed or bimodal distribution of a steady-state proxy (ppGpp alarmone level) across replicate seeds rather than a tight, single value — i.e. genetic identity does not imply expression identity.
drafts.h1: Across isogenic seeds of wildtype/basal, the per-seed distribution of ppgpp_conc (and corroborating ribosome_conc) shows high intrinsic noise: coefficient of variation (CV) >= 0.25, and the pooled per-seed values are better described as bimodal (Sarle's bimodality coefficient BC > 0.555) than as a single tight peak.
drafts.h0: Per-seed ppgpp_conc values across isogenic wildtype/basal replicates are tightly clustered (CV < 0.25) and unimodal (BC <= 0.555), consistent with deterministic, noise-free expression at the population level.

operational_defs.observable: ppgpp_conc
operational_defs.measure: per-seed steady-state ppGpp concentration (uM), pooled across >=6 seeds; compute CV and Sarle's BC over the pooled distribution

operational_defs.observable: ribosome_conc
operational_defs.measure: per-seed steady-state active ribosome concentration (uM), same seeds, used as a second channel to check the noise claim is not channel-specific

operational_defs.observable: wildtype/basal reference design
operational_defs.measure: isogenic replicates varying only random seed, no genetic or media perturbation

drafts.predicted_effect: Pooled ppgpp_conc across >=6 isogenic seeds will show CV >= 0.25 (vs. an expected CV < 0.1 if cells were deterministic) and Sarle's bimodality coefficient BC > 0.555 (right-skewed/bimodal), i.e. a >2.5x spread in relative terms beyond simple measurement noise.

falsifier.decision_rule: Compute Sarle's bimodality coefficient (BC) over the pooled per-seed ppgpp_conc values from wildtype/basal (n>=6 seeds, 2 generations); reject H1 (unimodal, low-noise) if BC <= 0.555 AND CV < 0.25 across seeds.
falsifier.refuting_result: Pooled ppgpp_conc values cluster tightly (CV < 0.25) and BC <= 0.555, i.e. isogenic cells converge to essentially one expression level, disconfirming substantial intrinsic noise.

test.statistic: sarle_bimodality_coefficient
test.threshold: BC > 0.555 (and CV >= 0.25) to support H1; BC <= 0.555 refutes

rivals.claim: Rival A (extrinsic-noise-dominated): any observed variability is driven by extrinsic factors (growth-rate/division asynchrony across the population) rather than intrinsic stochastic gene expression — i.e. cells are expressing identically per unit growth state, but sampled at different cell-cycle phases.
rivals.distinguishing_result: If extrinsic/cycle-phase variance dominates, ppgpp_conc variability should strongly covary with growth_rate and division_rate across seeds (high correlation), and controlling for cell-cycle phase (via generations=1, tightly synchronized single-division runs) should collapse CV well below 0.25.

rivals.claim: Rival B (simulator artifact / insufficient stochasticity): the whole-cell model's steady-state charging module is near-deterministic and any apparent spread is numerical/sampling noise rather than biological bimodality.
rivals.distinguishing_result: If this rival is true, increasing seeds (replicate count) should not reveal any structured bimodal splitting (bimodality_bc stays <=0.555 regardless of n), and the distinguishing control (rrna_operon_knockout, which perturbs ribosome capacity and should shift the ppGpp distribution) would show NO shift either, implying the module is insensitive to real biological perturbation and the baseline spread is just solver jitter.

auxiliary_assumptions: Steady-state charging module's ppgpp_conc reading is a valid proxy for 'gene expression level' noise at the population scale asked by the question (expression of alarmone synthesis/response pathway), not a direct single-gene mRNA/protein count readout.
Seed-to-seed variation in the simulator is intended to represent genuine intrinsic + extrinsic biological stochasticity, not pure solver/numerical noise (Rival B addresses residual doubt here).
8 seeds x 2 generations gives adequate power to distinguish CV>=0.25 vs <0.25 and to estimate BC; if underpowered, this is flagged via the auxiliary scope caveat rather than iterated indefinitely.

Division asynchrony/growth-rate differences across seeds are an acceptable source of extrinsic noise within the H1 claim's scope (cell-to-cell expression variability includes both intrinsic and extrinsic sources) unless Rival A's correlation test shows it dominates.

drafts.question: Do genetically identical cells express the same gene at the same level?
drafts.claim: Isogenic E. coli cells growing under identical conditions (wildtype/basal) show substantial cell-to-cell variability in gene expression output, operationalized as the per-seed distribution of fraction_trna_charged (a proxy for active translation/expression flux) and ribosome_conc (a proxy for expression capacity) across replicate stochastic seeds: the coefficient of variation (CV) across seeds is large (CV >= 0.15, i.e. >=15%) rather than near-zero, reflecting intrinsic noise in gene expression rather than deterministic uniformity.
drafts.h1: Across isogenic replicate seeds under identical wildtype/basal conditions, the across-seed CV of ribosome_conc (and/or fraction_trna_charged) is >= 0.15, indicating substantial intrinsic expression noise between genetically identical cells.
drafts.h0: Across isogenic replicate seeds under identical wildtype/basal conditions, the across-seed CV of ribosome_conc (and fraction_trna_charged) is < 0.15 (effectively uniform expression), i.e. variability is within replicate/simulation noise floor and not biologically meaningful.

operational_defs.observable: ribosome_conc and fraction_trna_charged sampled per seed at a fixed generation under wildtype/basal
operational_defs.measure: coefficient of variation (CV = sd/mean) computed across seeds

operational_defs.observable: wildtype perturbation with identical params, only seed varied
operational_defs.measure: design label wildtype/basal with seeds=8, generations=3

operational_defs.observable: same channel CV computed in a second independent wildtype/basal replicate batch (different seed set)
operational_defs.measure: CV compared between two independent seed batches to confirm CV is not an artifact of a single batch

drafts.predicted_effect: Direction: positive (nonzero) variability. Magnitude: CV of ribosome_conc across 8 seeds >= 0.15 (i.e. >=15% coefficient of variation), and fraction_trna_charged CV >= 0.10; this is substantially above an assumed simulator noise floor of ~5% CV for a deterministic/uniform process.

falsifier.decision_rule: Compute CV of ribosome_conc across the 8 seeds in each of two independent wildtype/basal replicate batches (target batch A vs reference batch B, same condition/params, different seed draws). Also run power_mde to confirm n=8 seeds can detect a CV difference from a null of CV<0.15. Reject H1 (treat as noise-floor artifact) if the observed CV in BOTH batches is <0.15 and the power_mde check shows n=8 is adequately powered to detect CV=0.15 against the floor.
falsifier.refuting_result: Both batches show ribosome_conc CV < 0.15 across seeds, and power_mde confirms adequate sensitivity at n=8, meaning real cell-to-cell variability is not detectably above the simulator's stochastic noise floor.

test.statistic: CV (sd/mean) across seeds; minimum detectable effect at n=8
test.threshold: CV >= 0.15 required to reject H0; power_mde must confirm MDE <= 0.15 at n=8 for the test to be decisive

rivals.claim: Rival A (deterministic/averaging rival): Any apparent variability across seeds is purely numerical/integration noise from the ODE/FBA solver, not biological stochasticity — i.e., the model is near-deterministic at this population size and seed variation reflects solver tolerance, not gene-expression noise.
rivals.distinguishing_result: If true, CV across seeds in wildtype/basal would be indistinguishable from CV in a rrna_operon_knockout or ppgpp_conc-clamped background (which removes a key stochastic feedback loop) — i.e., disconfirm(wildtype/basal, ppgpp_conc_clamp/basal, ribosome_conc) would show welch_t < 2, meaning clamping a key regulatory node does not reduce variability, consistent with pure solver noise rather than biological regulatory noise.

rivals.claim: Rival B (bursty transcription/translation rival): Variability is real and large but is driven specifically by stochastic bursting in a few low-copy regulatory proteins (e.g., RelA) rather than being a general feature of the whole translation apparatus — predicting that rela_conc CV is much larger than ribosome_conc CV.
rivals.distinguishing_result: If true, CV(rela_conc) across seeds would be much higher (e.g. >=0.5) than CV(ribosome_conc) (e.g. ~0.1-0.15), i.e. noise is concentrated in low-abundance regulators, not distributed broadly across the expression machinery as H1 claims.

auxiliary_assumptions: The simulator's intrinsic stochastic seed-to-seed variation is a valid proxy for biological cell-to-cell expression noise (the model's noise-generating mechanisms approximate real intrinsic/extrinsic noise sources).

Per-seed snapshots at a fixed generation (gen 3) are comparable across seeds despite potential phase differences in the cell cycle; we assume division_rate ~1 (no major division defects) so snapshots are not confounded by survivorship.

fraction_trna_charged and ribosome_conc are adequate operational proxies for 'gene expression level'; we are not directly measuring single-gene mRNA/protein counts per seed but a pathway-level aggregate, which is an acknowledged scope limitation of the available channels.
CV thresholds (0.15, 0.10, 0.05 floor) are provisional conventions chosen to be clearly above typical numerical/integration noise; they are not derived from an external corpus value.

params.note: clamp at basal level to remove stringent-response feedback stochasticity as a discriminating/interventional control
relA KO abolishes ppGpp burst production, isolating whether rival B's regulator-driven noise depends on RelA

drafts.question: Do genetically identical cells express the same gene at the same level?
drafts.claim: Genetically identical E. coli cells growing in the same static medium exhibit substantial cell-to-cell variability in gene expression output (here, in the stringent-response regulon as read out by ppGpp and RelA levels), rather than uniform expression — i.e. isogenic populations are noisy, not deterministic clones.
drafts.h1: Across isogenic replicate seeds under identical (wildtype/basal) conditions, the per-seed distribution of ppgpp_conc (and rela_conc) shows substantial dispersion — coefficient of variation (CV) >= 0.25 — rather than collapsing to a single tight value, and this dispersion is not an artifact of condition differences (a wildtype/acetate condition shift should NOT be needed to produce comparable spread).
drafts.h0: Isogenic replicate seeds under identical conditions show tight, low-noise expression: CV of ppgpp_conc (and rela_conc) across seeds < 0.25, i.e. the population behaves as if all cells express the gene at essentially the same level, with observed spread attributable only to measurement/replicate noise at the simulator's floor.

operational_defs.observable: per-seed values of ppgpp_conc and rela_conc under wildtype/basal, pooled across >=6 seeds
operational_defs.measure: coefficient of variation (CV = SD/mean) of the pooled per-seed channel values; also Sarle's bimodality coefficient to check for sub-populations

operational_defs.observable: wildtype perturbation with no gene_knockout, no tf_activity clamp, no ppgpp_conc clamp -- only seed varied
operational_defs.measure: design label wildtype/basal with seeds=1..8

operational_defs.observable: comparison of wildtype/basal CV against a near-deterministic reference design (ppgpp_conc clamped to 1x basal, which removes biological noise in that channel by fixing it)
operational_defs.measure: CV(wildtype/basal) vs near-zero CV(ppgpp_conc clamp) -- if clamp CV is near machine-precision and wildtype CV is far above it, variability is biological not numerical

drafts.predicted_effect: Direction: isogenic wildtype seeds show NON-trivial dispersion in ppgpp_conc (and rela_conc), not uniformity. Magnitude: predict pooled CV(ppgpp_conc) across 8 seeds >= 0.25 (i.e. >=25% relative spread), versus CV < 0.05 for the ppgpp_conc-clamped control (which removes stochastic synthesis/degradation noise by fixing the clamp). Distribution shape: unimodal but broad (not bimodal) is the baseline expectation -- bimodality coefficient should stay <=0.555 unless a genuine bistable subpopulation emerges.

falsifier.decision_rule: Welch t of ppgpp_conc, wildtype/basal (pooled per-seed values, n=8) vs ppgpp_conc-clamped/basal (n=8); reject H0 (claim variability is biological, not floor noise) if |welch_t|>=2 AND the wildtype pooled CV >=0.25. If instead wildtype/basal CV < 0.25, H1 is refuted regardless of the t-test outcome.
falsifier.refuting_result: Pooled CV(ppgpp_conc) across 8 wildtype/basal seeds is <0.25 (e.g. 0.05-0.10), indistinguishable in spread from the ppgpp_conc-clamped control -- isogenic cells express at essentially the same level and the apparent variability claim is refuted.

test.statistic: welch_t and per-seed CV of ppgpp_conc
test.threshold: |welch_t|>=2 AND wildtype CV>=0.25 to confirm H1; CV<0.25 refutes H1

rivals.claim: Rival A (deterministic-clone hypothesis): observed spread across seeds is purely simulator numerical/sampling noise at the floor, not real biological cell-to-cell variability -- true isogenic cells would show near-identical expression if the model had infinite precision.
rivals.distinguishing_result: If true, CV(wildtype/basal) would be statistically indistinguishable from CV(ppgpp_conc-clamped/basal) (the clamp removes stochastic kinetics but keeps the same measurement/discretization noise) -- Welch t |t|<2 and both CVs <0.1.

rivals.claim: Rival B (bistable-switch hypothesis): variability is not continuous noise but reflects two discrete sub-populations (e.g. a stringent-ON and stringent-OFF state) rather than a smoothly dispersed single population.
rivals.distinguishing_result: Bimodality coefficient (BC) computed on pooled wildtype/basal ppgpp_conc values would exceed 0.555, revealing a clear two-cluster split rather than the broad-unimodal shape H1 predicts.

rivals.claim: Rival C (condition-driven variability hypothesis): any observed spread is driven by subtle media/condition heterogeneity across runs rather than intrinsic stochastic gene expression -- isogenic cells in a truly fixed condition would be uniform.
rivals.distinguishing_result: Since all wildtype/basal seeds use the identical static 'basal' condition (no timeline shift, no condition change), if CV were still high this rules out condition-driven variability as the sole explanation; if rival C is right, repeating under rrna_operon_knockout/basal (a different background perturbation holding condition fixed) should show the SAME proportional CV collapse to near-zero, which would instead point to condition artifacts.

auxiliary_assumptions: Seeds in this simulator encode independent stochastic realizations of intrinsic biochemical noise (transcription/translation bursts, partitioning at division), analogous to true isogenic cell-to-cell variation -- not merely pseudo-random numerical artifacts without biological interpretation.

ppgpp_conc and rela_conc are adequate proxies for 'gene expression level' of the stringent-response regulon; we are not claiming this generalizes to every gene in the genome without further screening.
3 generations is sufficient to reach a representative, non-transient expression state per seed (avoiding pure initial-condition transients dominating the measured spread).

The ppgpp_conc clamp at 1x basal is accepted as the best available near-deterministic/noise-floor control in this envelope, since no pure 'disable stochasticity' switch exists; residual CV in the clamp run is attributed to measurement/discretization floor, not biology.
Basal condition is held static (no timeline media shift) across all seeds so that any observed spread cannot be attributed to a scheduled environmental change.

select_score.question: Do genetically identical cells express the same gene at the same level?
select_score.claim: In an isogenic E. coli population growing in identical (basal) medium, gene expression readouts (ppGpp concentration and tRNA-charging fraction, as proxies for expression-linked physiological state) show substantial cell-to-cell variability (intrinsic noise) rather than a single fixed level: across independent stochastic seeds, the coefficient of variation (CV) of ppgpp_conc is >=20%, i.e. cells are NOT expressing identically despite identical genotype and environment.
select_score.h1: Across isogenic replicate seeds under identical wildtype/basal conditions, per-seed ppgpp_conc (and fraction_trna_charged) values show a CV >= 20%, reflecting substantial intrinsic expression noise between genetically identical cells.
select_score.h0: Per-seed ppgpp_conc values under wildtype/basal are tightly clustered (CV < 20%, effectively deterministic given genotype+environment), i.e. isogenic cells express the gene/pathway at essentially the same level, with only negligible measurement-level scatter.

hypothesis.question: Do genetically identical cells express the same gene at the same level?
hypothesis.claim: Isogenic E. coli cells growing under identical (basal) conditions exhibit substantial cell-to-cell variability in gene expression output, quantified here via ribosome concentration and ppGpp concentration as proxies for the translational/stringent-response machinery, such that the across-seed coefficient of variation (CV) in these channels is large (CV >= 15%) rather than near-zero as expected if expression were deterministic across isogenic cells.
hypothesis.h1: Across independent stochastic replicates (seeds) of genetically identical wildtype cells in the same static condition, the per-seed distribution of ribosome_conc (and ppgpp_conc) shows substantial dispersion: CV >= 15%, reflecting intrinsic gene-expression noise rather than measurement/replicate artifact.
hypothesis.h0: Per-seed values of ribosome_conc (and ppgpp_conc) across isogenic wildtype replicates are tightly clustered (CV < 15%), i.e. expression is effectively deterministic given the condition, with only negligible stochastic variation.

operational_defs.measure: mean and CV of ppgpp_conc across seeds within a design

operational_defs.measure: coefficient of variation (CV) and bimodality coefficient (BC) over pooled per-seed values

hypothesis.predicted_effect: Isogenic replicates show CV(ribosome_conc) >= 15% and CV(ppgpp_conc) >= 20% across seeds at matched condition/generation, with the pooled per-seed distribution approximately unimodal (BC <= 0.555) — i.e., substantial but continuous (not bimodal) noise, consistent with intrinsic stochastic gene expression rather than a bistable switch.

falsifier.decision_rule: Compute coefficient of variation (CV = SD/mean) of ribosome_conc across the 8 seeds at generation 3; separately compute Sarle's bimodality coefficient (BC) over the pooled per-seed values. Also run power_mde to confirm 8 seeds can detect a 15% CV effect above intrinsic replicate noise floor. Reject H1 (isogenic variability is negligible) if CV < 15% AND the power check shows this is not simply an underpowered null.
falsifier.refuting_result: CV(ribosome_conc) < 15% across seeds with power_mde confirming adequate sensitivity at n=8 to detect 15% CV — i.e., isogenic cells are near-deterministic in ribosome concentration, refuting substantial intrinsic noise.

test.threshold: CV>=15% to confirm H1; refute if CV<15% and MDE at n=8 is <15% (i.e. well-powered to detect and still null)

rivals.claim: Apparent variability is driven mainly by cell-cycle/division-timing differences across seeds (extrinsic, deterministic-given-age noise), not by intrinsic stochastic gene expression per se.
rivals.distinguishing_result: If variability collapses (CV drops sharply) when comparing seeds at matched generation/division-cycle phase rather than wall-clock generation count, extrinsic cell-cycle phase — not intrinsic noise — explains most of the spread.

rivals.claim: Observed spread is an artifact of insufficient replicate sampling (seed-count too low), not a real biological signature of cell-to-cell heterogeneity.
rivals.distinguishing_result: If power_mde shows that at n=8 seeds the minimum detectable CV is itself >15%, the measured CV cannot be distinguished from sampling noise, so the apparent heterogeneity claim is underpowered rather than confirmed.

rivals.claim: Variability is primarily driven by stringent-response (ppGpp) pathway bistability/switching rather than general stochastic expression noise across the whole translational apparatus.
rivals.distinguishing_result: A relA gene_knockout (interventional control removing ppGpp synthesis capacity) that still shows comparable CV in ribosome_conc across seeds would indicate the noise is NOT ppGpp-pathway-specific but reflects broader intrinsic expression stochasticity; if CV collapses in the relA knockout, ppGpp-driven switching was the dominant source.

candidate_designs.timeline: optional scale-up only if n=8 underpowered per power_mde

drafts.question: Do genetically identical cells express the same gene at the same level?
drafts.claim: Isogenic E. coli cells growing under identical conditions show substantial cell-to-cell variability in gene expression output rather than uniform expression: across seeds (intrinsic stochastic replicates) at wildtype/basal steady state, a representative expression-proxy channel (ribosome_conc, as a proxy for translational output tied to gene expression capacity) will show coefficient of variation (CV) >= 0.20 across seeds, and the amino-acid charging channel (fraction_trna_charged) will likewise show detectable per-seed spread rather than collapsing to a single value — i.e. gene expression in isogenic populations is heterogeneous, not deterministic given genotype.
drafts.h1: Across isogenic replicate seeds under identical (wildtype/basal) conditions, single-cell-level readouts of gene expression output (ribosome_conc as proxy, fraction_trna_charged) exhibit substantial variability (CV >= 0.20 for ribosome_conc), reflecting intrinsic stochastic gene expression noise rather than a fixed deterministic level set purely by genotype+environment.
drafts.h0: Isogenic cells under identical conditions express genes at effectively the same level: per-seed variability in ribosome_conc and fraction_trna_charged is small (CV < 0.20), consistent with deterministic/mean-field expression with only negligible replicate noise (sampling/numerical noise only).

operational_defs.observable: ribosome_conc (active ribosome concentration, a bulk proxy for translational/expression capacity) and fraction_trna_charged (charging state reflecting amino-acid supply-demand coupled to expression)
operational_defs.measure: per-seed steady-state value of each channel at the final generation, pooled across seeds within a design

operational_defs.observable: distribution of per-seed values of ribosome_conc / fraction_trna_charged within the wildtype/basal design across independent stochastic seeds
operational_defs.measure: coefficient of variation (CV = std/mean) across seeds; compared against replicate/numerical noise floor via Welch t and bimodality checks

operational_defs.observable: shape and spread of the per-seed distribution; whether CV exceeds a noise-floor threshold and/or distribution is bimodal (bistable expression) vs unimodal-narrow (deterministic)
operational_defs.measure: CV threshold (>=0.20) and Sarle's bimodality coefficient (BC) on pooled per-seed values

drafts.predicted_effect: Isogenic wildtype/basal seeds will show CV(ribosome_conc) >= 0.20 across seeds (roughly 20-40% relative spread), i.e. a 1.2-1.4-fold typical seed-to-seed range, NOT a tight <5% numerical-noise-only spread. fraction_trna_charged will show detectable but smaller spread (CV ~0.05-0.15) since it's buffered by charging kinetics. We predict the distribution is unimodal (BC <= 0.555) but with wide spread -- i.e. continuous stochastic noise, not bistable switching, under basal unperturbed conditions.

falsifier.decision_rule: Compute CV of ribosome_conc across seeds for wildtype/basal design (n=8 seeds). This is a within-design dispersion test (not a between-design mean comparison), implemented as: resample seed values into two matched-size half-splits and apply welch_disconfirm between the half-splits to confirm no spurious mean-shift (i.e. confirm the spread is noise, not a bug), and separately use power_mde to establish that at n=8 seeds the design has power to detect CV=0.20 (i.e. MDE for a mean-shift at this n is well below the dispersion implied by CV=0.20). Reject H1 (fall back to H0) if observed CV(ribosome_conc) < 0.20 AND fraction_trna_charged CV < 0.05, i.e. per-seed spread is within numerical-noise floor rather than biological stochasticity.
falsifier.refuting_result: Observed CV(ribosome_conc) across the 8 wildtype/basal seeds is < 0.20 (e.g. 0.03-0.05), indicating seeds converge to nearly identical expression levels -- consistent with H0 (deterministic expression, negligible intrinsic noise) and refuting the claim of substantial isogenic heterogeneity.

test.statistic: CV (std/mean) across seeds; power_mde used to confirm n=8 is sufficient to resolve CV>=0.20 from noise floor
test.threshold: CV(ribosome_conc) >= 0.20 required to confirm H1; refuted if CV < 0.20 and MDE analysis confirms n=8 had power to detect that effect size

rivals.claim: Rival A (extrinsic-noise-dominant): any observed variability across seeds is NOT intrinsic gene-expression stochasticity but is driven by extrinsic fluctuations in global resource allocation (e.g. ppGpp/growth-rate coupling) that correlate across many channels together -- i.e. cells differ in overall physiological state, not independently in each gene.
rivals.distinguishing_result: If Rival A is true, ribosome_conc variability across seeds should be strongly correlated with simultaneous growth_rate and ppgpp_conc variability within the SAME seeds (all channels move together per seed), and a rrna_operon_knockout (capacity-clamping control) that removes ribosome-synthesis flexibility should COMPRESS ribosome_conc CV toward near-zero because the extrinsic driver (ribosome allocation capacity) is removed -- if instead CV(ribosome_conc) stays >=0.20 under rrna_operon_knockout, that argues against a purely extrinsic/ribosome-capacity-driven account and favors intrinsic per-gene noise.

rivals.claim: Rival B (numerical/sampling-noise-only): the observed spread across seeds is purely an artifact of the stochastic solver/sampling scheme (pseudo-random seeding of a near-deterministic ODE/FBA integration) and does not reflect biologically meaningful cell-to-cell variability.
rivals.distinguishing_result: If Rival B is true, increasing generations (longer integration, e.g. gen 1 vs gen 4) should NOT change CV (it would stay flat since it's just solver noise), and CV should be of similar tiny magnitude across ALL channels regardless of known noisy biological steps (e.g. fraction_trna_charged should show the same CV as ribosome_conc even though charging is a different noise-generating process) -- if CV instead DIFFERS systematically across channels and GROWS with generations, that argues for genuine accumulating biological stochasticity rather than pure numerical artifact.

auxiliary_assumptions: Seeds in this simulator are the operational analog of isogenic single cells / biological replicates under identical environment -- i.e. seed-to-seed variance at fixed condition is interpreted as a proxy for cell-to-cell variability in a real isogenic population (the simulator does not literally model a spatial population of cells dividing together).

ribosome_conc and fraction_trna_charged are adequate (if imperfect) proxies for 'gene expression level' in a whole-cell model that does not report individual mRNA/protein copy-number noise directly at this summary-channel level; a sharper single-gene readout (e.g. a specific mRNA/protein species trajectory) is not assumed available and is out of scope here.

The noise floor (what counts as 'numerical-noise-only' CV) is assumed to be well below 0.20 based on typical stochastic whole-cell simulator behavior; this is an assumption the power_mde check partially validates but does not independently calibrate from first principles.

We assume generations 1-3 are sufficient for the system to reach a quasi-steady distributional state at which seed-to-seed spread is meaningfully comparable; very early transients are not separately modeled out.

We treat rrna_operon_knockout as the closest in-envelope interventional control for isolating ribosome-capacity-driven (extrinsic) noise from intrinsic per-gene noise, acknowledging it is a coarse background perturbation rather than a perfect mechanistic isolator.

drafts.question: Do genetically identical cells express the same gene at the same level?
drafts.claim: In an isogenic E. coli population growing under identical, constant conditions, individual cells show substantial cell-to-cell variability in gene expression even though they share the same genome — i.e. intrinsic/extrinsic noise produces a broad, non-degenerate distribution of expression level across replicate cells (seeds) rather than a single fixed value, with coefficient of variation (CV) on the order of 15-40% for a representative expressed gene/channel and a non-trivial right-skew/heavy tail rather than a tight unimodal spike.
drafts.h1: Across isogenic replicate simulations (same genotype, same condition, differing only in stochastic seed), the per-seed distribution of a representative expression-linked channel (ribosome_conc, as a proxy for translational output of the house-keeping expression machinery) has CV >= 15% and is NOT a degenerate point-mass; i.e. seeds differ meaningfully beyond simulator floating-point/sampling noise.
drafts.h0: Isogenic replicate seeds under identical condition produce essentially the same expression level for the representative channel: CV < 5% (effectively deterministic output), consistent with noise being negligible at the whole-cell coarse-grained scale this simulator resolves.

operational_defs.measure: coefficient of variation (CV = SD/mean) of ribosome_conc across seeds, and Sarle's bimodality coefficient (BC) of the pooled per-seed distribution to test for multimodal/non-degenerate shape
